proofs.text: Build the strong cell of a rule whose only proof is tagged `@manual`; verify the cell reads `needs a person` with the reason `manual proof`

rule_text: A rule proved by a `@manual` proof reads `needs a person` with the reason `manual proof`

tests.body:
def test_a_manual_proof_needs_a_person(self):
        cell = _strong(risk='low', proofs=[
            {'id': 'PROOF-1', 'tier': 'manual', 'env': None, 'text': 'x',
             'findings': [], 'tests': []}])
        assert cell['word'] == 'needs a person'
        assert cell['reasons'] == ['manual proof'], cell
